analogy.rationale: TBXA2R is a prostanoid-family G protein-coupled receptor with limited expression in most of these cell lines, so thromboxane receptor antagonists should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other prostanoid receptor ligands, with weaker similarity to other lipid mediator receptor antagonists.
